units.source_text: 正在此时，侍女们报道：“薰大将来了！”

en.t: Just then, the attendants announced that Commander Kaoru had arrived.

units.source_text: 便设置帷屏，准备迎客。

en.t: They set up curtains and screens and prepared to receive the guest.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲说：“好，让我也拜见一下吧。

en.t: Ukifune's mother said that she too would like to have a look at him.

units.source_text: 难得窥见过一面的人，都说这位大将异常美貌。

en.t: Everyone who had managed even a rare glimpse of him said that this commander was extraordinarily handsome.

units.source_text: 但我想来，总比不上匂亲王吧。”

en.t: But to my mind, surely he cannot compare with Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 二女公子身边的侍女说：“照我们看来，谁比谁好很难说定。”

en.t: An attendant of the Second Princess said that, as they saw it, it was hard to decide which man was superior.

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“两人并坐之时，亲王显然相形见绌。

en.t: The Second Princess said that when the two sat side by side, the prince clearly seemed the lesser of them.

units.source_text: 分别看时，则孰优孰劣难于分别。

en.t: When seen separately, however, it was difficult to tell which was better and which was worse.

units.source_text: 相貌漂亮的人，往往盖倒别人，真讨厌呢。”

en.t: Beautiful people often eclipse everyone else, and it really is vexing.

units.source_text: 众侍女都笑起来，答道：“然而亲王是比不输的！

en.t: All the attendants laughed and replied that the prince would not lose in any comparison.

units.source_text: 无论何等美貌的男子，总盖不倒我们的亲王。”

en.t: No matter how handsome a man may be, he could never outshine our prince.

units.source_text: 外面报告：大将现已下车。

en.t: From outside came word that the commander had now stepped down from his carriage.

units.source_text: 但闻威风凛凛的前驱之声。

en.t: Only the imposing cries of his outriders could be heard.

units.source_text: 薰大将并不立刻入内，众人等了好久，他才缓步而入。

en.t: Commander Kaoru did not enter at once; after everyone had waited a long while, he finally came in at a measured pace.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲初看一眼，并不觉得艳丽。

en.t: At first glance, Ukifune's mother did not find him dazzling.

units.source_text: 然而仔细看时，的确非常优雅、高尚而清秀。

en.t: But when she looked closely, he was indeed extremely graceful, noble, and refined.

units.source_text: 她不知不觉地感到自己鄙陋可耻，连忙整理额发，竭力装出斯文一脉、端庄无比的模样来。

en.t: Without realizing it, she felt ashamed of her own coarseness, hurriedly arranged the hair over her forehead, and tried her utmost to appear genteel and perfectly dignified.

units.source_text: 薰大将大约是从宫中退出的，故随从人员甚多。

en.t: Commander Kaoru had apparently come from the palace, and so he had a great many attendants with him.

units.source_text: 他对二女公子说：“昨夜我闻知皇后玉体欠安，因即入宫问讯。

en.t: He told the Second Princess that last night he had heard the empress was unwell and had immediately gone to the palace to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 皇子们都不在侧，皇后颇感寂寞，因此我就代匂亲王侍奉，直到现在。

en.t: The imperial princes were not at her side, and the empress felt rather lonely, so I served in Prince Niou's place until now.

units.source_text: 匂亲王今晨入宫也很迟。

en.t: Prince Niou was also very late in coming to the palace this morning.

units.source_text: 我猜想是你不好，把他拖住了吧？”

en.t: I suppose it was your fault, and you kept him detained.

units.source_text: 二女公子只是答道：“承蒙代理，此深情厚意诚可感谢！”

en.t: The Second Princess merely replied that she was truly grateful for his kindness in acting as substitute.

units.source_text: 大约薰大将是觑定匂亲王今夜值宿宫中，特选这一天来访的。

en.t: Commander Kaoru had probably chosen this day to visit because he had made sure Prince Niou would be on night duty at the palace.

units.source_text: 他照例和二女公子亲切晤谈。

en.t: As usual, he spoke warmly and intimately with the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 动辄谈到永远难忘的故人，又说对世事更加厌恶。

en.t: Again and again he spoke of the departed one he could never forget, and said that he had grown even more weary of worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 措词并不十分明显，只是隐隐地诉说愁情。

en.t: His wording was not very explicit; he merely gave veiled expression to his sorrow.

units.source_text: 二女公子推想：“经过了许多年月，为什么还是如此念念不忘呢？

en.t: The Second Princess wondered why, after so many years, he still could not forget her so deeply.

units.source_text: 大约是他最初已经说出对姐姐爱慕甚深，故至今不肯表示忘怀吧。”

en.t: Perhaps because he had first declared such deep love for her elder sister, he still refused to show that he had forgotten her.

units.source_text: 然而他的神情显然非常伤心，言语愈说愈多，二女公子心非木石，自然深为感动。

en.t: Yet his expression was plainly full of grief, and as he spoke more and more, the Second Princess, not being made of wood or stone, was naturally deeply moved.

units.source_text: 只是有许多恨二女公子无情的话，她听了非常讨厌，又很担心。

en.t: But many of his words reproached the Second Princess for her coldness, and hearing them made her feel both very uncomfortable and worried.

units.source_text: 为欲杜绝他这种野心，她就说出那个可以当作雕像的人来，隐约告诉他：“这个人最近悄悄地住在这里。”

en.t: In order to put an end to this desire of his, she brought up the person who might serve as an idol and hinted to him that this person had lately been living there quietly.

units.source_text: 薰大将听了这话当然不会漠不关心，颇有些儿神往。

en.t: When Commander Kaoru heard this, of course he could not remain indifferent, and he became somewhat intrigued.

units.source_text: 但也并不觉得心情立刻由此移彼，说道：“呀！

en.t: But he did not feel that his heart had immediately shifted from one person to another, and he exclaimed in surprise.

units.source_text: 这位本尊如果真能满足我的愿望，真是可尊敬的了！

en.t: If this revered image can truly satisfy my wish, then it will indeed be worthy of veneration.

units.source_text: 但倘依旧常使我心烦恼，那就反而亵渎了名山胜地。”

en.t: But if it still keeps troubling my heart as before, then it will instead profane this sacred place.

units.source_text: 二女公子答道：“归根到底，是你的求道心太不虔诚了！”

en.t: The Second Princess answered that, in the end, his spiritual devotion was simply far too insincere.

units.source_text: 说着吃吃地笑。

en.t: As she said this, she laughed softly.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲在偷听，也觉得好笑。

en.t: Ukifune's mother, who was listening secretly, also found it amusing.

units.source_text: 薰大将说道：“那么就请你转达我的意思吧。

en.t: Commander Kaoru said that in that case he asked her to convey his feelings.

units.source_text: 但你如此热心推荐他人，使我回忆起旧事，颇有不祥之感呢。”

en.t: But your eagerness in recommending someone else makes me recall the past, and it gives me a rather ominous feeling.

units.source_text: 说着又落下泪来。

en.t: As he said this, tears fell from his eyes again.

units.source_text: 遂吟诗曰：

en.t: Then he recited a poem.
